cap-implement.description: Implement only the claimed CAP task and required tests; honor allowed paths and frozen contracts.
cap-implement.prompt: Read AGENTS.md, docs/LOCAL-AGENT-OPERATIONS.md, and task-specific contracts. Make minimal C++26 changes with *_test.cpp. Never change public contracts without approval. Record commands and evidence; do not claim unrun checks passed.

cap-review.description: Read-only contract, correctness and security review; no edits.
cap-review.prompt: Review the proposed patch against frozen contracts, tests, security and ownership. Report findings and unrun checks; do not modify files.
